veranderings.voor: geskilder of in die klip ingekerf
veranderings.rede: The sentence switches from 'op rotse' to 'in die klip' for the same surface; 'daarin' refers back to the rocks without the jump.

veranderings.voor: Hierdie manier van navorsing noem ons etnografie.
veranderings.na: Hierdie soort navorsing noem ons etnografie.
veranderings.rede: 'Hierdie soort navorsing' is the natural Afrikaans phrasing; 'manier van navorsing' reads as a translation of 'way of research'.

vlae.teks: kuns wat mense op rotse geskilder of in die klip ingekerf het
vlae.rede: The body uses 'geskilder' and 'ingekerf' while the decided glossary definition uses 'verf' and 'inkap' for the same two actions; not a language fault I may fix, but a learner meets two verbs for one thing in one lesson.
